## Motivation

Add focused regression coverage for --constrained-json-max-whitespace-cnt, ensuring that CLI configuration reaches XGrammar and that JSON Schema matching and token masks enforce the configured limit.

## Modifications

- Add test/registered/unit/constrained/test_xgrammar_whitespace.py with 10 CPU unit tests using a small synthetic vocabulary.
- Cover the unbounded default and limits of 1 and 2, including spaces, tabs, LF newlines, mixed whitespace, and boundary conditions.
- Verify that each whitespace run has its own budget and that spaces inside string values remain unrestricted.
- Test token masks for tokens containing multiple whitespace characters, accumulated whitespace across tokens, and budget resets.
- Register the tests in base-a-test-cpu.

## Accuracy Tests

Model accuracy benchmarks are not applicable because this PR adds tests only.

Validated in an Ascend container with XGrammar 0.2.1:

- New test module: 10 passed.
- New tests and related grammar regression tests: 53 passed.
- Repository-configured isort and Ruff checks: passed.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable; this PR adds tests only.

## Checklist

- [ ] Run full pre-commit checks. isort and Ruff checks have passed.
- [x] Add focused unit tests and register them for CPU CI.
- [ ] Update documentation — not applicable for this test-only change.
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmarks — not applicable for this test-only change.
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style guidance.

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the PR Merge Process.
2. Get approvals from CODEOWNERS and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with comments or contact authorized users. Common commands include /tag-and-rerun-ci, /tag-run-ci-label, and /rerun-failed-ci.
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

detail.title: [Test] constrained: Cover JSON whitespace limits

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,166 @@
+"""NPU end-to-end tests for the `--constrained-json-max-whitespace-cnt` feature.
+
+These tests launch a real SGLang server on Ascend NPU with the xgrammar grammar
+backend and verify that the constrained JSON output only contains at most
+`MAX_WHITESPACE_CNT` consecutive whitespace characters, while remaining valid
+JSON with the expected field types.
+"""
+
+import json
+import unittest
+
+import openai
+import requests
+
+from sglang.srt.utils import kill_process_tree
+from sglang.test.ascend.test_ascend_utils import (
+    LLAMA_3_2_1B_INSTRUCT_WEIGHTS_PATH as MODEL_PATH,
+)
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_npu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import (
+    DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_FOR_SERVER_LAUNCH,
+    DEFAULT_URL_FOR_TEST,
+    CustomTestCase,
+    popen_launch_server,
+)
+
+# Max consecutive whitespace characters allowed in constrained JSON output.
+MAX_WHITESPACE_CNT = 1
+
+# Whitespace characters that may be emitted between JSON tokens.
+WHITESPACE_CHARS = {" ", "\t", "\n", "\r"}
+
+JSON_SCHEMA = json.dumps(
+    {
+        "type": "object",
+        "properties": {
+            "name": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^[\\w]+$"},
+            "population": {"type": "integer"},
+        },
+        "required": ["name", "population"],
+        "additionalProperties": False,
+    }
+)
+
+register_npu_ci(est_time=360, suite="nightly-npu-a3-merged", nightly=True)
+
+
+class TestNpuConstrainedJsonWhitespace(CustomTestCase):
+    """Testcase: Verify that --constrained-json-max-whitespace-cnt limits the number
+    of consecutive whitespace characters in xgrammar constrained JSON output on NPU.
+
+    [Test Category] Interface
+    [Test Target] /generate; /v1/chat/completions
+    """
+
+    @classmethod
+    def setUpClass(cls):
+        cls.model = MODEL_PATH
+        cls.base_url = DEFAULT_URL_FOR_TEST
+        other_args = [
+            "--grammar-backend",
+            "xgrammar",
+            "--constrained-json-max-whitespace-cnt",
+            str(MAX_WHITESPACE_CNT),
+            "--attention-backend",
+            "ascend",
+            "--mem-fraction-static",
+            "0.8",
+        ]
+        cls.process = popen_launch_server(
+            cls.model,
+            cls.base_url,
+            timeout=DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_FOR_SERVER_LAUNCH,
+            other_args=other_args,
+        )
+        cls.client = openai.Client(api_key="EMPTY", base_url=f"{cls.base_url}/v1")
+
+    @classmethod
+    def tearDownClass(cls):
+        kill_process_tree(cls.process.pid)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _max_consecutive_whitespace(text):
+        """Return the length of the longest whitespace run in text."""
+        longest = 0
+        current = 0
+        for ch in text:
+            if ch in WHITESPACE_CHARS:
+                current += 1
+                longest = max(longest, current)
+            else:
+                current = 0
+        return longest
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _assert_valid_json(text):
+        js_obj = json.loads(text)
+        assert isinstance(js_obj["name"], str), "name must be a string"
+        assert isinstance(js_obj["population"], int), "population must be an int"
+        return js_obj
+
+    def run_generate_json(self):
+        # Use the raw /generate endpoint with json_schema in sampling_params.
+        response = requests.post(
+            self.base_url + "/generate",
+            json={
+                "text": (
+                    "Introduce the capital of France. Return in a JSON format. "
+                    "The JSON Schema is: " + JSON_SCHEMA
+                ),
+                "sampling_params": {
+                    "temperature": 0,
+                    "max_new_tokens": 128,
+                    "json_schema": JSON_SCHEMA,
+                },
+                "stream": False,
+            },
+        )
+        ret = response.json()
+        print(json.dumps(ret))
+        print("=" * 100)
+        text = ret["text"]
+
+        assert self._max_consecutive_whitespace(text) <= MAX_WHITESPACE_CNT, (
+            f"constrained JSON output has >{MAX_WHITESPACE_CNT} consecutive whitespace: {text!r}"
+        )
+        self._assert_valid_json(text)
+
+    def run_chat_completions_json(self):
+        response = self.client.chat.completions.create(
+            model=self.model,
+            messages=[
+                {"role": "system", "content": "You are a helpful AI assistant"},
+                {
+                    "role": "user",
+                    "content": (
+                        "Introduce the capital of France. Return in a JSON format. "
+                        "The JSON Schema is: " + JSON_SCHEMA
+                    ),
+                },
+            ],
+            temperature=0,
+            max_tokens=128,
+            response_format={
+                "type": "json_schema",
+                "json_schema": {"name": "capital", "schema": json.loads(JSON_SCHEMA)},
+            },
+        )
+        text = response.choices[0].message.content
+        print(json.dumps(text))
+        print("=" * 100)
+
+        assert self._max_consecutive_whitespace(text) <= MAX_WHITESPACE_CNT, (
+            f"constrained JSON output has >{MAX_WHITESPACE_CNT} consecutive whitespace: {text!r}"
+        )
+        self._assert_valid_json(text)
+
+    def test_json_generate_with_whitespace_limit(self):
+        self.run_generate_json()
+
+    def test_json_chat_completions_with_whitespace_limit(self):
+        self.run_chat_completions_json()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
